item.title: Motorcyclist killed in crash on Highway 1
item.description:
A motorcyclist in his 30s was killed in a crash on Highway 1.
Magen David Adom paramedics and EMTs performed resuscitation efforts, but ultimately pronounced him dead at the scene.

item.title: Three dead, multiple injured in Minneapolis shooting, incident not an act of terror
item.description: At least three people are dead and multiple others injured after a shooting in downtown Minneapolis, including two police officers. Incident appears to be criminal in nature.

item.title: Ukraine: Russian attack causes heavy damage to residential building in Odesa
item.description: A Russian airstrike caused extensive damage to a high-rise residential building in the southern Ukrainian port city of Odesa on the Black Sea coast, according to Serhii Lysak, head of the city’s military administration.

item.title: Netanyahu on Iran: We will defeat this regime, it will fall
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu tells i24NEWS that Israel is working to bring down the Iranian regime: “We will defeat this regime."

item.title: Young man moderately to seriously injured in violent incident in Shibli
item.description:
A young man in his 20s was moderately to seriously injured in a violent incident in Shibli.
Magen David Adom teams provided him with medical treatment before evacuating him to HaEmek Hospital in Afula.

item.title: Mamdani visits Borough Park ahead of Rosh Hashanah, woman confronts him
item.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani visits a haredi Judaica store in Borough Park ahead of Rosh Hashanah, where one woman confronts him over antisemitism.

item.title: Two terrorists eliminated by security forces near Ramallah, IDF investigating
item.description:
Two terrorists were eliminated and another Palestinian Arab was critically wounded by gunfire from Israeli security forces in the village of al-Mughayyir near Ramallah.
The troops opened fire after Palestinian Arabs hurled cinder blocks at them during an operation to locate livestock that had been stolen from Jews.
The IDF Spokesperson's Unit said that the incident and the events that preceded it are under investigation.
